title: Konkrete issue #22: Crash

text:
[issue by TheWanderingTrader]
Forge crashes on launch saying that concrete needs forge version 55.0.9

Forge 55.0.9 is loaded on my client.

Removing Koncrete solves this issue of crashing.

Potentially koncrete is not identifying the 55.0.9 jar?

[comment by Keksuccino (owner)]
That makes no sense. It wouldn't crash if the correct Forge version would be installed.
